intro: One transform sound per Gulp form, from your round-3 wish. The game already plays option A for each (for the Frog, the Bubbly pop take 3 you named). Pick one per form, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.

groups.name: A transform sound for each form
groups.note: From your round-3 wish: the Heavy like rock, the Frog with splashes or bubbles like Bubbly pop take 3. The Sticky had no wish, so it gets silk and glue takes. Each plays as the slime gulps into that form (the eat sound plays too).

cues.name: Heavy
cues.where: Gulping stone: the slime turns into rock

options.label: Rock crunch
options.note: A stone crunch and grinding shift ending in a low thud

options.label: Boulder thunk
options.note: A rocky rumble, clacking pebbles and a deep thunk

cues.name: Sticky
cues.where: Gulping silk: the slime turns sticky

options.label: Silk stretch
options.note: A gooey squelch, strands pulling apart and a tacky snap

options.label: Gluey boing
options.note: A syrupy stretch, a sticky smack and a tiny boing

cues.name: Frog
cues.where: Gulping a frog: the slime can swim

options.label: Your pick: Bubbly pop 3
options.note: Round 3's Bubbly pop take 3, as you asked

options.label: Splash and bubbles
options.note: A gloopy wobble, a small splash, rising bubbles and a pop
